versions.subject: Added rule for TerraMaster TOS CVE-2020-28188
versions.detection:
base_url:
    cs-method: 'GET'
    c-uri|contains|all:
        - '/include/makecvs.php'
        - '?Event='
payload:
    c-uri|contains:
        - 'curl'
        - 'wget'
        - '.py'
        - '.sh'
        - '.php'
        - 'chmod'
        - '_GET'
condition: base_url and payload
